Input1: current apartment360 panorama is GEOMETRY/ADJACENCY evidence ONLY, NOT output projection. Keep the existing floor plan, original doors/windows and all previously approved functional layouts. Correct straight verticals and a real28-32mm architectural lens, plausible small-apartment proportions. Every visible edge, reveal, textile seam and fixture must look built, not generic CGI: fine open wood grain at realistic scale, tiny eased edge, satin non-plastic metal, actual separate fabric weave, coherent tiled joints, properly supported shelves, meaningful surface contact shadows. Natural soft NEUTRAL daylight plus just a few local warm task pools; readable white balance, no overall yellow/orange haze, HDR halos or artificial blur. No people, text, visible brand logos, watermarks or cloned botanical art everywhere. This is an original home design informed by published general design principles, not a reproduction of a designer's named project.

Visible kitchen:2.30m north counter, northeast fridge, .85m east auxiliary, two TOP-HUNG clear glass banks OPEN and compactly stacked at ends, no floor rail or corner post, no island.
VISIBLE IMPROVEMENTS: Refine table edge thickness, believable chair-to-table proportion, wood joinery and bench seat cushion, coffee-machine/grinder tray, four carefully spaced cups, credible small under-shelf work light, actual electrical sockets and concealed wire route. Quiet washable backsplash behind coffee surface, closed bottom storage, a real pendant centered on table not floating randomly.

stylingCorrection.prompt:

Keep camera, projection, original room scale, all built-ins, bed/desk/TV/sofa positions, windows, doors, materials, colour and light EXACTLY. User wants meaningful lived-in small decorations and coherent item placement, NOT random objects and NOT a bare showroom. Arrange a small number of functional personal items in thoughtful groupings, realistic hand-reach, coordinated muted natural palette, varied heights, credible contact shadows; no readable writing, people, logos or watermark. Do NOT add large furniture, new windows, arches, kitchen islands or extra floor clutter.
LIVED-IN STYLING: coffee machine and grinder together on one fitted washable tray, THREE practical cups grouped on rail/shelf within hand reach, one folded tea towel, a small handwritten-style note/postcard board WITHOUT readable lettering next to coffee corner; keep machine lid working and sockets reachable. Dining table has a modest linen runner, low fruit/ceramic bowl and two daily cups, at least half tabletop empty; one small framed personal print and low bud vase on sideboard only. Every object belongs to coffee or eating ritual, varied heights, not scattered matching flower vases and fake potted plants.
These are modest daily objects; preserve at least half of working/table surfaces free. Do not turn this into an advertisement or cluttered decor shop. Keep source3:2 aspect and its native sharp detail.
